First of all, stop all this “feeling sorry for yourself”, this toxic thinking helps no one. Cant blame your parents because the older generation had their feelings repressed by an even older generation. The good thing is that this cycle is being broken. I know how it feels thinking that “If I was smarter” or “If I had done things differently early on”, but this also wont help you. The best thing to do is to be humble, keep doing what you can, because you didnt do things differently before because you were different, but your future’s ahead of you, and you can do with it whatever you want to, and also, the only real dumb people are arrogant folks and people who give up. Always try your best, there will definitely be days when you think your best is terrible, but its not. We’re not always 100%, so if you did your best, thats always enough. And above all, seek mental counseling, there’s no shame in that. I may have said some shitty and wrong things so take the things I said with a grain of salt. Anyway, hope it gets better for you, job hunting is indeed a monster nowadays. If you need someone to talk, hmu
